about: The shared cases of the deploy that the publishing tool starts after a push (issue 32, BUILD-02, PUB-42). Both faces read them: apps/plugin/src/publishing/deploy.spec.ts and cli/src/deploy.rs. "commands": the settings of a device (an empty text is a setting that is not set), whether the run is a takedown, and the command that the tool runs (the program, its arguments, and the folder where it runs), or the error of a deploy report that deploys nothing. A path is absolute when it starts with "/" in these cases; a face uses the rule of its system. "results": the exit code of the deploy (null: stopped by a signal), its standard output, and the deploy report that the tool gives, as the "deployment" object of its output ("startError": the deploy could not start, with this message of the system).

commands.name: a takedown adds --takedown at the end
no env file and no bun program: bun of the path of the system, and no --env-file
a path with spaces and quotes stays one argument
no folder of the site code deploys nothing and names the setting
commands.error: nothing was deployed: the folder of the site code is not set (in the settings of Vault Publish, or --site-code of the command line program)

commands.name: no target file deploys nothing and names the setting
commands.error: nothing was deployed: the target file of the deployment is not set (in the settings of Vault Publish, or --deploy-target of the command line program)

commands.name: neither the site code nor the target names both
commands.error: nothing was deployed: the folder of the site code and the target file of the deployment are not set (in the settings of Vault Publish, or --site-code and --deploy-target of the command line program)

commands.name: no copy of the content store and no attachment storage name them too
commands.error: nothing was deployed: the folder of the site code, the copy of the content store and the attachment storage are not set (in the settings of Vault Publish, or --site-code, --content-store and --attachment-storage of the command line program)

commands.name: a folder of the site code that is not absolute deploys nothing
commands.error: nothing was deployed: the folder of the site code must be an absolute path: "site-code"

commands.name: an env file that is not absolute deploys nothing
commands.error: nothing was deployed: the env file of the deployment must be an absolute path: "deploy.env"

commands.name: a bun program that is not absolute deploys nothing
commands.error: nothing was deployed: the bun program must be an absolute path: "bin/bun"

commands.name: a target file that is not absolute deploys nothing
commands.error: nothing was deployed: the target file of the deployment must be an absolute path: "target.json"
